Self-registered point in the 'Unidades productivas / Quintas /Huertas con venta directa' layer of the Rutas Sanas del Alimento map, kept by the Red Interregional de Nodos Agroecologicos. It publishes the unit's coordinates, its declared production and the contact route the producer entered; entries carry no date and no review. Seventeen years of agroecological production declared, with yerba mate as the line for sale, membership of the Caficla cooperative and its separate milling, seed keeping and farm tourism, plus the holder's mobile.

Self-registered point in the 'Unidades productivas / Quintas /Huertas con venta directa' layer of the Rutas Sanas del Alimento map, kept by the Red Interregional de Nodos Agroecologicos. It publishes the unit's coordinates, its declared production and the contact route the producer entered; entries carry no date and no review. Declares a group of families producing cooperatively at Colonia San Miguel under the Productos IX brand of agroecological products, with a mobile and an email.

Own site of the community, between El Soberbio and the Moconá falls in the buffer zone of the Yabotí biosphere reserve: sustainable farming, fruit production and processed products for fairs and distribution, with the turmeric harvest and turmeric powder as the winter line.

Self-registered point in the 'Unidades productivas / Quintas /Huertas con venta directa' layer of the Rutas Sanas del Alimento map, kept by the Red Interregional de Nodos Agroecologicos. It publishes the unit's coordinates, its declared production and the contact route the producer entered; entries carry no date and no review. Declares an agroecologically certified holding (SUCP) with yerba mate, fruit trees, vegetables, apis and yateí honey, jams and preserves and livestock, at Lote 139 sección V, with a mobile and an email.

Self-registered point in the 'Unidades productivas / Quintas /Huertas con venta directa' layer of the Rutas Sanas del Alimento map, kept by the Red Interregional de Nodos Agroecologicos. It publishes the unit's coordinates, its declared production and the contact route the producer entered; entries carry no date and no review. Sixteen years at Colonia Gisela declared, with the surface breakdown, the six hectares of Demeter-certified yerba mate and founding membership of the La Abundancia cooperative; the contact line it publishes is not a usable address.

Self-registered point in the 'Unidades productivas / Quintas /Huertas con venta directa' layer of the Rutas Sanas del Alimento map, kept by the Red Interregional de Nodos Agroecologicos. Registers the cooperative at Puerto Rico and publishes its Facebook page and email.

Own site of the Cooperativa Agropecuaria La Abundancia Ltda.: a cooperative of organic producers adding value to Misiones farming families' crops, with a working shop of 41 priced products - Arapeguá yerba mate, mother tinctures, syrups - a cart and a checkout, the phone and a WhatsApp route. It gives only 'Provincia de Misiones' as its address.

notes: Parcial because the cooperative's own site gives no municipality; Puerto Rico comes from the map and from the El Once registration, which names Puerto Rico as the cooperative's seat.

sources.note: Self-registered point in the 'Unidades productivas / Quintas /Huertas con venta directa' layer of the Rutas Sanas del Alimento map, kept by the Red Interregional de Nodos Agroecologicos. The entry is titled with the activity rather than a trade name and declares organic waste management, the generation of fertiliser substrate and biomass fuels, plus a family garden, at Barrio El Porvenir 2, Posadas.

notes: Real project, but its declared output is waste treatment, substrate and renewable fuel; the only food is a family garden for its own table, with no offer under a producer identity.
